import csv, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
revisions = ('4b2e30231c20d3374a39976df5a0f998a6c6f90c', 'd43e63c8872c4029c7edb9067d8f272642e7885a')
observations = []
for revision in revisions:
    source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{revision}:corpus/instruments/resolve.py'], cwd=repo)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mirror-smoke-') as tmp:
        fixture = pathlib.Path(tmp)
        home, mirror, lane, instrument = (fixture / name for name in ('home','mirror','lane','instrument'))
        for directory in (home, mirror, lane / 'corpus', instrument):
            directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        targets = [mirror / 'ops/rank.mjs', mirror / '.omp/config.yml']
        for target in targets:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text('fixture source\n', encoding='utf-8')
        tokens = ['~/Projects/the-bounty-hunter/ops/rank.mjs:1', str(home / 'Projects/the-bounty-hunter/.omp/config.yml') + ':1', 'ops/rank.mjs:1', '~/Projects/the-bounty-hunter/ops/missing.mjs:1']
        (lane / 'SKILL.md').write_text('# Relocated mirror citations\n' + '\n'.join(f'`{token}`' for token in tokens) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        (instrument / 'resolve.py').write_bytes(source)
        p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B',str(instrument / 'resolve.py'),str(lane)], cwd=repo, text=True, capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ,HOME=str(home),KASEGI_MIRROR=str(mirror),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
        assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
        with (instrument / 'citation-survival.tsv').open() as f:
            rows = {row['citation']:row for row in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')}
        n = sum(rows[token]['class']=='RESOLVES' and pathlib.Path(rows[token]['resolved_path']).resolve()==target.resolve() for token,target in zip(tokens[:2],targets))
        row = {'revision':revision,'resolver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'cli_exit':p.returncode,'explicit_resolved':n,'explicit_total':2,'relative_control':rows[tokens[2]]['class'],'missing_control':rows[tokens[3]]['class'],'stdout':p.stdout.strip(),'stderr':p.stderr}
        print(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
        observations.append(row)
assert [o['explicit_resolved'] for o in observations] == [0,2]
assert all(o['relative_control']=='MIRROR-EQUIVALENT' and o['missing_control']=='GONE' for o in observations)
print('COPIED_CLI_SMOKE: PASS explicit_expected_paths=0/2->2/2 controls=unchanged')
